# Phase 04 — UI Design Contract

> Visual and interaction contract for frontend phases. Generated by gsd-ui-researcher, verified by gsd-ui-checker.

**Scope note:** This phase lets a steward pick tools from a shed's list and move them to another shed, cancel a move, retry a failed one, confirm a removal and read the history (MOVE-01..05). It is the last v1.0 phase and adds no second design system: every token, spacing step and type role below comes unchanged from phases 2 and 3 (`components.json`, `frontend/app/globals.css`, `top-bar.tsx`, `shed-card.tsx`, `catalogue-table.tsx`).

Most visual choices here come straight from `04-CONTEXT.md`. The few left open there (the badge look, the shape of the Keep/Move toggle, how the move panel docks) are settled here instead of being asked again.

---

## Design System

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Tool | shadcn (already initialized — `components.json`) |
| Preset | `k7Tmw2Qe9x` — **locked, standing directive**; `npx shadcn info` reports style `base-linden`, base color `stone`, theme `green`, font `space-grotesk`/`jetbrains-mono`, `cssVariables: true`. Do not re-run `shadcn init`; do not add a second theme. |
| Component library | **base-ui** (`@base-ui/react`, imported by every installed primitive such as `button.tsx`). Not Radix. |
| Icon library | `lucide-react` (used across `shed-card.tsx` and `catalogue-row.tsx`) |
| Font | `Space Grotesk` — `--font-sans` (body text), `JetBrains Mono` — `--font-heading` (headings and dialog titles). Both are loaded already; this phase adds none. |

**Already installed (phases 2 and 3):** `Card`, `Badge`, `Progress`, `Alert`, `Skeleton`, `Button`, `Tabs`, `Breadcrumb`, `Switch`, `Table`. Reuse them; do not reinstall.

**New primitives this phase needs:**

| Component | Used for |
|-----------|----------|
| `Checkbox` | Row selection in the catalogue, and a select-all in the header |
| `Dialog` | The move picker, the clash prompt and the removal confirmation |
| `Input` | The new-shelf name field inside the move picker |

---

## Spacing Scale

Declared values (must be multiples of 4):

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| xs | 4px | Icon-to-label gaps in badges |
| sm | 8px | Gaps in a move row's meta line |
| md | 16px | Dialog body padding on narrow screens |
| lg | 24px | Section padding; page padding |
| xl | 32px | Gap between the Active and History sections |
| 2xl | 48px | Height of the collapsed move panel strip |

**Exceptions:**
- **44px minimum touch target** carried forward from phases 2 and 3, applied to every row checkbox and every dialog action.
- **Panel max-height: 320px**, a new declared multiple of 4, so the panel can never fill the viewport.

---

## Layout

**Focal points (one per surface):**

| Surface | Focal point | Why it wins the eye |
|---------|-------------|---------------------|
| Move row | The progress bar and its percentage | The only animated element in the row |
| History page | The Active section | Sits first and carries the live motion |
| Selection bar | The `Move to…` button | The only accent-filled element in the bar |

### Selection bar (D-01, D-02)

A strip with the summary on the left and `Move to…` plus `Clear` on the right; it is not mounted at zero selection.

### Move panel (D-14)

Docked at the foot of the page, 48px collapsed, up to 320px expanded, scrolling inside itself.

## Typography

| Role | Size | Weight | Line Height | Used for (this phase) |
|------|------|--------|-------------|------------------------|
| Label | 14px | 400 (regular) | 1.5 | Meta line, captions, table cells |
| Body | 16px | 400 (regular) | 1.5 | Selection summary, dialog text |
| Heading | 20px | 600 (semibold) | 1.2 | Dialog titles and page titles |
| Display | 28px | 600 (semibold) | 1.2 | The progress percentage |

**Weights:** two only — regular (400) and semibold (600).

---

## Color

No new values — every choice resolves to a token already in `frontend/app/globals.css`.

| Role | Value | Usage |
|------|-------|-------|
| Dominant (60%) | `--background` / `--card` | Page, dialog and panel surfaces |
| Secondary (30%) | `--secondary` / `--muted` / `--border` | Dividers, disabled chrome, history rows |
| Accent (10%) | `--accent` — **never `--primary`** | See the list below |
| Destructive | `--destructive` | See the list below |

**Accent (`--accent`) reserved for:**
1. The `Move to…` button fill
2. The dialog's main confirm fill
3. A running move's progress fill on a healthy shed
4. A finished move's status icon
5. The checked state of the row checkbox
6. The active history filter tab

**Destructive (`--destructive`) reserved for:**
1. The removal dialog's action button
2. The clash dialog's `Replace them` action
3. A failed move's icon and badge text
4. An interrupted move's icon
5. The progress fill on a failing shed

**Explicitly not destructive:** cancelling a running move, and a queued move's status.

---

## Motion & Reduced-Motion Contract

- An unknown-length progress bar sweeps by default; under reduced motion it pulses slowly instead of freezing.
- A known-length bar eases its width over about 200ms and snaps under reduced motion.
- The panel's open and close takes about 150ms and snaps under reduced motion.

---

## Screen-Reader / Live-Region Contract

- A frequently changing number never sits in a live region.
- A rare, meaningful change (a move finishing or failing) is announced politely.

---

## Copywriting Contract

| Element | Copy |
|---------|------|
| Selection summary | **"{N} selected"** |
| Main action | **"Move to…"** |
| Clash title | **"{N} of {M} tools already sit on that shed"** |
| Removal title | **"Remove {N} tools from {shed}?"** |
| Empty history | **"No moves yet"** with **"Pick tools from any shed list to start one."** |

## UI Considerations

> Populated by the ui-phase UI-consideration probe (Step 9.5) and lifted by plan-phase's
> `## UI Considerations` lift rule via the identical rule as SPEC `## Edge Coverage`. Shape-rooted UI *state*
> coverage (empty / loading / error / populated / partial / overflow / zero-one-many / long-text).

Probe run over **6 elements** (E1 selection bar, E2 move picker, E3 clash dialog, E4 removal dialog, E5 move row, E6 history page).

**Coverage: 45 applicable → 31 covered · 3 backstop · 11 dismissed (reasoned) · 0 unresolved.**

*Kind confirmation.* Detected kinds spanned form, list and control across all six elements, so no kind was missed. Three considerations the context could not answer were settled with the user and are tagged **P-01** and **P-02** below.

### E1 — Selection bar

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | Not mounted at zero selection. |
| populated | ✅ covered | Summary left, `Move to…` and `Clear` right. |
| overflow | ✅ covered | Actions wrap beneath the summary on narrow screens. |
| zero-one-many | ✅ covered | The count template folds the plural in. |
| long-text | ✅ covered | The summary holds a count only. |
| loading | ⊘ dismissed | Selection is local state; nothing is fetched. |
| error | ⊘ dismissed | Selection cannot fail. |
| partial | ⊘ dismissed | A selection is a set; no item is half selected. |

### E2 — Move picker dialog

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | A shed with no shelves reuses the catalogue's empty look. |
| loading | ✅ covered **(P-01)** | Skeleton rows while the shed list resolves. |
| error | ✅ covered **(P-02)** | Inline alert with the real reason and a retry. |
| populated | ✅ covered | Shed switcher, trail, shelf list, toggle and confirm. |
| partial | ✅ covered | An empty shelf name keeps `Create` disabled. |
| overflow | ✅ covered | The list scrolls inside the dialog body. |
| zero-one-many | ✅ covered | The title carries the count. |
| long-text | 🧪 backstop | A very long shelf name must truncate without widening the dialog. **Verification: backstop** — try a name over 200 characters. |

### E3 — Clash dialog

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| loading | ✅ covered **(P-01)** | The check runs before the dialog opens. |
| error | ✅ covered **(P-02)** | A failed check shows an alert in the picker and starts nothing. |
| populated | ✅ covered | Title, subtitle, scrolling list and three actions. |
| overflow | ✅ covered | The list scrolls and the action row stays pinned. |
| zero-one-many | ✅ covered | The title carries both counts. |
| long-text | 🧪 backstop | Long names must wrap. **Verification: backstop** — same check as E2. |
| empty | ⊘ dismissed | Opened only when at least one clash was found. |
| partial | ⊘ dismissed | The clash set is whole or the check failed. |

### E4 — Removal dialog

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| populated | ✅ covered | Full tool list, total count, danger action and a Cancel with focus. |
| zero-one-many | ✅ covered | Title template with the count. |
| overflow | 🧪 backstop | The list must scroll and never push Cancel off screen. **Verification: backstop** — use a 50-tool selection. |
| long-text | ✅ covered | One long name wraps inside the list. |
| empty | ⊘ dismissed | Never opened with nothing to confirm. |
| loading | ⊘ dismissed | Every name is known before it opens. |
| error | ⊘ dismissed | A pure decision surface. |

### E5 — Move row

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| loading | ✅ covered | A queued row has no bar; an unknown-length row sweeps. |
| error | ✅ covered | Failed, interrupted and paused shapes are distinct. |
| populated | ✅ covered | Three lines: summary, current tool, bar and readout. |
| partial | ✅ covered **(P-01)** | Finished-with-failures and cancelled-midway are both named. |
| overflow | ✅ covered | The current-tool line ellipsizes with a title. |
| zero-one-many | ✅ covered | The item count template reads "1 item". |
| long-text | ✅ covered | Odd names pass through one formatter. |
| empty | ⊘ dismissed | A row exists only because a move exists. |

### E6 — History page

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | The empty-history copy, no illustration. |
| loading | ✅ covered | Skeleton rows at the one-line height. |
| error | ✅ covered | Alert with reason and retry, scoped to the section. |
| populated | ✅ covered | One-line rows expanding in place. |
| partial | ⊘ dismissed | The fetch resolves or fails. |
| overflow | ⊘ dismissed | Page scroll only; the volume stays small. |
